Terraphim Agent: server-backed fullscreen TUI with offline-capable REPL and CLI commands

Usage: terraphim-agent [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  search        Search documents using the knowledge graph
  roles         Manage roles (list, select)
  config        Manage configuration (show, set, validate, reload)
  graph         Display the knowledge graph for a role
  kg            Manage knowledge graph entries
  chat          Chat with the AI using a specific role
  extract       Extract paragraphs matching knowledge graph terms from text
  replace       Replace terms in text using the knowledge graph thesaurus
  validate      Validate text against knowledge graph
  suggest       Suggest similar terms using fuzzy matching
  hook          Unified hook handler for Claude Code integration
  guard         Check command against safety guard patterns (blocks destructive git/fs commands)
  interactive   Start fullscreen interactive TUI mode (requires running server)
  repl          Start REPL (Read-Eval-Print-Loop) interface
  setup         Interactive setup wizard for first-time configuration
  check-update  Check for updates without installing
  update        Update to latest version if available
  learn         Learning capture for failed commands
  sessions      Session management for AI coding assistant history
  listen        Start listener mode for AI agent communication (offline-only)
  cache         Manage the compiled thesaurus cache
  robot         Robot mode self-documentation commands
  memory        Memory lifecycle management (capture, distill, scope, provenance, retrieve, apply, validate, retire, rubric, second-run)
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --server
          Use server API mode instead of self-contained offline mode

      --server-url <SERVER_URL>
          Server URL for API mode
          
          [default: http://localhost:8000]

      --transparent
          Enable transparent background mode

      --robot
          Enable robot mode for AI agent integration (JSON output, exit codes)

      --format <FORMAT>
          Output format (human, json, json-compact)

          Possible values:
          - human:        Human-readable output (default)
          - json:         Machine-readable JSON output
          - json-compact: Compact JSON for piping
          
          [default: human]

      --config <CONFIG>
          Path to a JSON config file (overrides settings.toml and persistence)

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version

EXIT CODES (F1.2 contract)

  0  SUCCESS             Operation completed successfully
  1  ERROR_GENERAL       Unspecified or unexpected error
  2  ERROR_USAGE         Invalid arguments or unknown command
  3  ERROR_INDEX_MISSING Required index not initialised
  4  ERROR_NOT_FOUND     No results (only with --fail-on-empty)
  5  ERROR_AUTH          Authentication required or failed
  6  ERROR_NETWORK       Transport-level network error
  7  ERROR_TIMEOUT       Operation exceeded configured timeout
